info.description: The Tugtupit Laptop Detail Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage and enhance their laptop catalog with detailed specifications and attributes. This API enables users to submit new laptop model details, including features, performance metrics, and pricing information. Ideal for retailers and manufacturers, the API supports actions related to product inventory and updates, ensuring users maintain an accurate and up-to-date laptop catalog. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline their product offerings and improve customer engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a Tugtupit laptop. It captures essential specifications and features required to describe the laptop accurately, ensuring all relevant data is submitted for processing.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating the details for the TugtuPit laptop. This should contain relevant information about the laptop's specifications, features, and any other pertinent data.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the details are returned.
